text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew. ...After this,
we'll be facing a series of steep uphills.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was rough~!
Messiah-san, you still seem pretty comfortable?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... Because Trainer told me beforehand to keep my pacing in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Considering your current stamina and the weather, let's proceed with "Menu A" after this...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Be mindful of your cadence on the mountain passes.
Get a feel for accelerating on the slopes," it says.
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Were those instructions from Messiah's Trainer as well? Might I take a look, for my own reference?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
! My, how meticulous...
Do you always prepare flowcharts like this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That is a lot of info!
Your Trainer really is something else."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
These are flowcharts for independent training,
covering weight training, tandem running...
You've prepared so many different kinds for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This many items of such high quality!?
Whoa... She's just as serious and dedicated as you are."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To me...? No.
They have always been a very serious person.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She's diligent and does meticulous work.
Never compromising, always pushing to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Which is why—
I, too, must train without making any compromises.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Shall we resume soon?
...Steadily and surely. For the sake of our respective victories.
